title: Master 3.2.0.1 Winter time open loop
symptom: During the winter time change, AAPS showed a message that the loop was not closed due to DST, but the UI still displayed the closed loop icon. In the OpenSMB tab, no loop mode was selected (not even open loop), and the usual 'update time in DASH pod' messages did not appear.
cause: The loop is intentionally deactivated for 3 hours after the DST switch for safety reasons (IOB too high due to duplicated bolus prior to DST change). The issue is that the UI does not correctly reflect this state: the closed loop icon remains displayed and the loop selection disappears without clear indication.
fix: No code fix was provided in the thread. Users suggested improving the UI to show a barred TZ or DST icon on the closed loop icon and to display an error message in the SMB/DynISF tab during the 3-hour deactivation period.
evidence_quote: To prevent difficulties the Loop will be deactivated for 3 hours AFTER the DST switch. This is done for safety reasons (IOB too high due to duplicated bolus prior to DST change).
